newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse suspends nine listed finance firms.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse suspends nine listed finance firms.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand on Friday suspended shares of nine listed finance companies which were among 16 finance companies ordered to stop operations pending their merger with other parties.

Finance One Plc, General Finance and Securities Plc, CMIC FInance and Securities, Dynanic Eastern Finance Thailand Plc, Prime Finance and Securities Plc, ITF Finance and Securities Plc, Thai Financial Trust Plc, G.C.N. Finance Plc and United Finance Corp.
Thai authorities earlier on Friday told 16 listed and unlisted finance companies to stop operations and submit plans to consolidate and merge within 14 days.

They said that there were five core companies with which the 16 firms could merge. The five core firms were Dhana Siam Finance and Securities Plc, Nava Finance and Securities Plc, National Finance and Securities Plc, Phatra Thanakit Finance and Securities Plc and Krungthai Thanakit Plc.

The plan to force finance company mergers comes on the heels of a near crisis in the ailing and cash-strapped Thai financial sector which has been hard hit by the worst economic downturn in over a decade.
